name: Bant
description: Bant is one of Alara's five shards, an orderly, sunlit kingdom defended in the name of its guardian angels.

summary.text: Bant is one of Alara's five shards, an orderly, sunlit kingdom defended in the name of its guardian angels.

bio.text: Alara's five shards converge into one plane flowing with all five colors of mana.
As the boundaries dissolve, cultures clash and wars break out between the shards, and Esper invades the others.
Bant's armies fight the horrors crossing their borders.

status.text: The latest event shows Bant's armies fighting the horrors crossing their borders, while a 2023 page mentions Estel being sent to Bant to warn the Knights of Bant.

timeline.summary: Alara's five shards converge into one plane flowing with all five colors of mana.
timeline.quote: But now they have converged into one, and the rejoined plane flows with all five colors of mana once more.

timeline.summary: As the boundaries dissolve, cultures clash and wars break out between the shards.
timeline.quote: As the boundaries between the shards dissolve, cultures clash and wars ensue.

timeline.summary: Naya's forces march out of the jungle searching for answers to the Anima's visions, and Bant's armies fight the horrors crossing their borders.
timeline.quote: And the armies of Bant clash with the horrors swarming over their borders, defending their homeland in the name of their guardian angels.

relations.quote: The five shards of Alara were separate worlds for centuries

relations.note: Esper invades the other shards, and the shards' legions pummel one another.
relations.quote: At each front, the shards' legions pummel one another with powerful magics

pages_say.description: A vast realm of floating castles, seas of grass and blue skies, where Kaalia grew up.
Where Gideon first planeswalks, as listed.
A shard of Alara Gideon thinks of as at risk.
A plane where Gideon lived and where the name Gideon stuck.
The shard to which Estel is sent to warn the Knights of Bant.
A shard of Alara: an orderly, sunlit kingdom defended in the name of its guardian angels.
